title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg Go v0.7.0 RC0
summary: zeroshade proposed release candidate RC0 of Apache Iceberg Go v0.7.0, based on commit 89a9104ec3639d38ab07e4461721cb5270e95571, with a vote open for at least 72 hours. Neelesh Salian verified the signature, checksum, license files and headers, that the tarball matches the tag, and the build and unit tests on Go 1.25.9. He flagged, as not a blocker, that the test puffin/TestReaderPreservesLZ4ChecksumError fails on Go 1.27.1 while passing on 1.25.9, and opened a fix. Xuanwo saw the same failure on Go 1.27.1, noted the call still rejected the corrupted input, and considered it non-blocking. Russell Spitzer cast a binding +1 after running the verification suite. The thread contains no result message.

positions.stance: The candidate verifies; a Puffin test fails on Go 1.27.1 but passes on the targeted Go 1.25.9, which is not a blocker and has a fix proposed.
The candidate verifies with 3,344 tests passing on Go 1.25.9; the Go 1.27.1 failure is an error-message assertion and is non-blocking.

outcome.note: No result is stated in the thread. The replies are +1 votes: one marked binding (RussellSpitzer) and three marked non-binding, with no 0 or -1 votes.

why_it_matters: A Puffin test in iceberg-go fails on Go 1.27.1 and needs the proposed fix before that Go version is added to CI.
